answer: Sybil resistance follows an exponential temporal half-life: each agent’s reputation decays continuously, so honest influence must be sustained rather than briefly manufactured. In EigenTrust matrix factorization, freshly spawned identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted inbound edges; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap them from isolated links. Thus consensus rejects a sybil plume, even when it scatters through a meadow-like cluster or a coordinated thread.
